data.name: FAQ_INTRO_TEXT
data.value: Answers to the questions we're asked most often. Can't find what you need?

data.name: FAQ_Q1_TITLE
data.value: How do I register my church?

data.name: FAQ_Q1_ANSWER
data.value: Get in touch through the Contact page. We'll email you a unique invitation link so you can create an account, then you can fill in your church's details, service times and events.

data.name: FAQ_Q2_TITLE
data.value: Other services do something similar — why use this one?

data.name: FAQ_Q2_ANSWER
data.value: Other services can list churches, but many charge for it, and it can be hard to find out which church is nearest. Forest Churches is free and built around searching by postcode, so you can quickly see what's close to you.

data.name: FAQ_Q3_TITLE
data.value: How do I get a copy of my personal data?

data.name: FAQ_Q3_ANSWER
data.value: In Church admin, open My data and choose Download. If you need anything that isn't included, contact us and we'll be happy to help.

data.name: FAQ_Q4_ANSWER
data.value: To keep your data safe, all information is stored in a secure external database that only the application itself can access.

data.name: FAQ_Q5_TITLE
data.value: My event disappeared from my church's page — why?

data.name: FAQ_Q5_ANSWER
data.value: To keep the database small and costs down, one-off events are removed up to 24 hours after they finish. Repeating events stay on the system.

data.name: FAQ_Q6_TITLE
data.value: How do I update my church's information?

data.name: FAQ_Q6_ANSWER
data.value: Sign in and open My church. You can change your details, facilities, service times and logo there.

data.name: FAQ_Q7_TITLE
data.value: Why can't I change the email address on my account?

data.name: FAQ_Q7_ANSWER
data.value: For security, email addresses can't be changed from the site. If you need to update yours, get in touch and we'll help.

data.name: FAQ_Q8_TITLE
data.value: Why isn't the link in my email working any more?

data.name: FAQ_Q8_ANSWER
data.value: Most links we email you are encrypted and only last 24 hours. If yours has expired, request a new one.

data.name: FAQ_Q9_TITLE
data.value: Why do some pages confirm my changes and others don't?

data.name: FAQ_Q9_ANSWER
data.value: Every page should now show a confirmation message after you save. If you spot one that doesn't, please let us know.

data.name: PRIVACY_INTRO_TEXT
data.value: This privacy policy explains how Forest Churches ("we", "our" or "us") collects, uses and shares personal information when you use this website.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_TEXT1
data.value: We may collect personal information that you give us when you use the site, including:

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM1
data.value: Contact details, such as your name, email address and phone number

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM2
data.value: Account sign-in details (your username and password)

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM3
data.value: Profile information, such as a profile picture and your preferences

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM4
data.value: Church information, such as website links and contact details

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_TEXT2
data.value: We may automatically collect non-personal information when you use the site, such as:

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM5
data.value: Log data, including IP address, browser type, operating system and times of access

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM6
data.value: Device information, such as the type of device you use

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM7
data.value: How you use the site and your preferences

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION1_ITEM8
data.value: Approximate location, based on your IP address or a postcode you give us

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_TEXT
data.value: We use the information we collect to:

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_ITEM1
data.value: Run the site and keep it working

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_ITEM2
data.value: Improve the site and make it easier to use

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_ITEM3
data.value: Reply to your messages and support requests

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_ITEM4
data.value: Show you accurate, up-to-date information, such as churches near you

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_ITEM5
data.value: Send occasional updates about the site

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION2_ITEM7
data.value: Meet our legal obligations and protect our rights

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION3_INTRO_TEXT
data.value: We only share personal information in these circumstances:

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION3_TEXT1
data.value: trusted companies that help us run the site (for example hosting and email) can access personal information only to do that work for us, and must keep it confidential.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION3_TEXT2
data.value: we may disclose information if the law, a court or a government body requires it, or to protect against fraud or security threats.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION4_TEXT
data.value: We keep personal information only for as long as we need it for the purposes in this policy, unless the law requires us to keep it longer. When we no longer need it, we delete it or make it anonymous.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION5_TEXT
data.value: We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from unauthorised access, disclosure, change or destruction. No method of sending or storing information online is completely secure, so we can't guarantee absolute security.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION6_TEXT
data.value: Church accounts are not intended for anyone under 18, and we don't knowingly collect personal information from children. If we find we have, we will delete it.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION7_TEXT
data.value: You have the right to see, correct or delete your personal information, or to restrict how we use it. You can also opt out of updates from us at any time. Signed-in users can download or delete their data from their account; for anything else, please contact us.

data.name: PRIVACY_SECTION8_TEXT
data.value: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we'll change the effective date at the top of this page. Please check back occasionally; continuing to use the site means you accept the updated policy.

data.name: PRIVACY_CONTACT_TEXT
data.value: If you have any questions or requests about this policy or how we handle your information, please

data.name: PRIVACY_CONTACT_LINK
data.value: get in touch through our contact page

data.name: PRIVACY_ACKNOWLEDGMENT
data.value: By using this site, you confirm you have read and understood this privacy policy.

data.name: FC_SVC_ERR_WEEKS
data.value: Choose at least one week of the month.

data.name: FC_SVC_ERR_DAY_OF_MONTH
data.value: Choose a date in the month.

data.name: FC_SVC_ERR_END_DATE
data.value: The last date can't be before the first date.

data.name: FC_SVC_ERR_LOCATION
data.value: Choose another church or enter an address, or turn off “Held somewhere else”.

data.name: FC_SVC_ERR_LOCATION_CHURCH
data.value: Choose one of your other churches.

data.name: FC_ADM_BENEFICES_LEAD
data.value: Group churches that are served together. Each church keeps its own page; the benefice links them. Put churches into a benefice from Churches → Edit.

data.name: FC_ADM_CONFIRM_DELETE_BENEFICE
data.value: Delete the {0} benefice? Its churches stay, they're just no longer grouped.

data.name: FC_ADM_ADD_CHURCH_LEAD
data.value: Add a church to an existing account, for example a benefice account that manages several churches.

data.name: FC_ADM_ADD_CHURCH_CLOSED_NOTE
data.value: New churches start Closed (hidden from the public) until their details are filled in and they're opened.

data.name: FC_ADM_ADD_ANOTHER_CHURCH
data.value: Add another church to this account

data.name: FC_ADM_MANAGED_BY_HINT
data.value: The church administrator account that will edit this church.

data.name: FC_ADM_BENEFICE_MGMT_LEAD
data.value: Put this church in a benefice, or hand it to another account, for example when the church gets its own administrator. It stays in its benefice either way.

data.name: FC_ADM_MOVE_HINT
data.value: Choosing a different account moves the church, its services and its events to that account.

data.name: FC_ADM_REMOVE_CHURCH_LEAD
data.value: Deletes this church and its services from the account. The account and its other churches stay. Events aren't deleted.

data.name: FC_ADM_CONFIRM_REMOVE_CHURCH
data.value: Remove {0} and its services? This can't be undone.
